Coram : N.V. RAMANA*, A.S. BOPANNA, HIMA KOHLI
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: Post award interest on the interest amount awarded – Held: Can be granted by Arbitrator. Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: s.34 – Jurisdiction under, Scope – Held: Court does not sit in appeal over the arbitral award and may interfere provided under s.34(2)(b)(ii). Arbitration: If there are two plausible interpretations of the terms and conditions of the contract then no fault can be found if the arbitrator proceeds to accept one interpretation as against the other.
